description: What a sanitized branch (branches.create data: "sanitized") masks. Every sanitized branch already hashes auth emails and phone numbers and removes sign-in metadata, password hashes and IP addresses; add the project's own columns as [schema.]table.column:transform (hash, null, mask or empty_json). Without rules it shows the current ones. Needs an owner or admin token. Scope: branches:write.

organization_id.description: Organization id. Optional: defaults to the token's organization, or the only one you belong to.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional: defaults to the project created or used last in this session, or the only one.

rules.description: The project's rules, replacing its current ones, e.g. ["profiles.full_name:mask"]

name: branches.masking.set
title: Set masking rules
